title: Kinds of Salah by importance
intro: Fard, wajib and sunnah prayers – and what each includes.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: O believers, bow and prostrate, worship your Lord and do good, so that you may succeed. <small>(Qur’an, Al-Hajj 22:77)</small>

Salah is the most important act of worship prescribed for Muslims – the time when a believer speaks with Allah. Salah is a pillar of the religion: whoever denies that it is a duty stops being a Muslim, and whoever does not pray the prescribed prayers commits a great sin. Allah made the five daily prayers a strict duty for every adult Muslim of sound mind, unless they have a valid reason. Besides them there are other required prayers, and voluntary (nafl) prayers at the level of sunnah.

items: the five daily prayers – 17 fard rak‘ahs a day: 2 Fajr, 4 Dhuhr, 4 Asr, 3 Maghrib and 4 Isha
3 rak‘ahs of witr, prayed with Isha
Confirmed sunnah (mu’akkadah) – the Prophet (SAW) always prayed them: 2 of Fajr, 6 of Dhuhr, 2 of Maghrib and 2 of Isha
Non-confirmed sunnah (ghayr mu’akkadah) – he sometimes left them: 4 of Asr and 4 of Isha, tahiyyat al-masjid, and nafl prayers for a need, like salat al-hajah, istikharah and the prayer for rain

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: Umm Habibah (RA) said she heard the Prophet (SAW) say: “Whoever prays twelve sunnah rak‘ahs in a day and night, a house will be built for him in Jannah.” (Muslim)
